simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲבָקָה (H81) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אֲבָקָה (ʼăbâqâh) means powder. First listed occurrence: Song 3 6.

definitions.full: H81. abaqah [ אֲבָקָה or אַבְקָה ] noun feminine probably collective, construct רוֺכֵל אַבְקַת Song 3:6 powders of merchant = scent-powders. (On formation compare Lag BN 81 .)
